pure-announcement.rationale: This is a first-person technique write-up applying the AlphaEvolve idea to an existing hobby agent, with a measured result and linked code, not a product or release announcement.

duplicate.rationale: None of the nearest concepts (retrieval composition, proxy capture, w2s sandbox, SIEM gap, code-mode MCP, context layer) touch evolutionary parameter search or fitness-function-driven agent tuning.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The claims are backed by the linked AlphaEvolve paper, a public repo with the harness in PR #9, and a concrete reproducible measurement (door_cooldown=4 beating 8 across 10 runs).

durability.rationale: The core division of labor — manual iteration to discover capabilities and build the fitness vocabulary, then parallel evolutionary search to tune parameters once the agent runs headless and fast — is a mechanism that stays true regardless of the Pokemon specifics or timing numbers.

actionability.rationale: It gives a transferable recipe — run headless at speed, expose parameters via environment, emit structured fitness JSON, race variants in subprocesses, and treat fitness-function design as the real work — that changes how someone would tune any agent's heuristics.

atomicity.rationale: One idea — race parameter variants against a fitness function instead of hand-tweaking — carries the whole note, with the fitness-function difficulty as a facet of it rather than a separate concept.
